Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.

Shri Suchit Tandon, learned AGA for the State contends that the police authorities in compliance of the directions issued by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 46998 of 2020 (Junaid Vs State of U.P. and another) reported at 2021 (6) ADJ 511 and with a view to implement the provisions of POCSO Act, 2012 read with POCSO Rules, 2020, have served the bail application upon the victim/legal guardian as well as upon the CWC.
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
339 of 2023 at Police Station-Ramala District-Baghpat under Sections 363, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

sentences.text: The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 16.08.2024.

The following arguments made by Shri Karunesh Mishra, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Ramraj Pandey, learned counsel assisted by Shri Subham Pandey, learned counsel for the first informant and Shri Suchit Tandon, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The victims were wrongly shown as minor of 17 and 14 years respectively in the F.I.R. only to falsely implicate the applicant under the stringent provisions of the POCSO Act and cause his imprisonment.
2.The age of the victim set out in the prosecution case is refuted in light of the judgement of this Court in Monish Vs. State of U.P. and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021) and on the following grounds:
(i) There are material contradictions in the age of the victim as recorded in various prosecution documents.
(ii) The age of the victims were incorrectly got registered in the school records by the victims' parents to give them an advantage in life.

entities.text: Monish Vs. State of U.P. and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is no lawful basis for the age related entry of the victims in the school records.
The school records disclosing their age as 17 and 14 years respectively are unreliable.
(iii) The victims in their statements under Section 161 Cr.P.C. have stated that they are 17 and 14 years of age respectively.
(iii) The victims in their statements under Section 164 Cr.P.C. have stated that they are 17 and 17 years of age respectively.
(iv) Medico-legal examination (not the age determination test) records that the victims are about 20 and 14 years of age respectively.
(v) The medical reports drawn up to determine the age of the victims opines that they are 20-21 and 17-18 years of age respectively.
In fact the victims are major.
3. The victim namely X (anonymized) was intimate with one Asif.
The victim Y (anonymized) had a love interest Furkan.
Both couples had eloped together to Pasauda by truck.
4. The F.I.R. was lodged after the said relationship got exposed and to deflect attention from the conduct of the victims.
5. The victim X in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. has admitted to intimacy with the said Asif and that she eloped with him of her own volition.

However, in the latter part of the said statement, false and aggravated allegations have been made against the applicant at the behest of Naushad vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114470937/
2 her parents only to deflect attention from her own conduct and to save the failing prosecution case.

entities.text: Naushad vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Subsequently the victim X in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has accepted her intimacy with the said Asif and also the fact of her elopement with him.
According to the said statement she had consensual physical relations with the said Asif.
The victim X has lastly stated that she wants to marry his love interest Asif.
She has not made any allegation of abduction, wrongful detention or commission of rape in the said statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. against the applicant.

Moreover,
the victim X has asserted that her sister was intimate with Furkan.
Both the couples resided in the same room.

7. False and aggravated allegations were made by the victim Y against the applicant in her statements under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. only to deflect attention from the conduct of her love interest Furkan.
8. The victims were never confined or bound down in any manner.
The victims were present at various public places.
They did not raise an alarm nor did they resist the applicant.
9. Major inconsistencies in the F.I.R. statements of the victim under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. discredit the prosecution case.
10. Medical evidence to corroborate commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.
11. The principal offender Asif has already been enlarged on bail by this Court by order dated 24.05.2024 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 16321 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 16321 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The case of the applicant stands on a better footing than that of aforesaid principal offender.
However, the applicant seeks parity in relief granted to the aforesaid principal offenders.
12. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
13. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Naushad be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
